Cautiously positive. The statement signals accommodative policy under average inflation targeting (Powell 2020) and is consistent with New Keynesian guidance that commitment and forward guidance/QE (Clarida, Galí, and Gertler; Woodford; Svensson and Woodford) support demand by anchoring expectations near 2%. However, COVID-related uncertainty and supply-chain shocks temper the outlook, keeping risks two-sided. Representative line: “Amid progress on vaccinations and strong policy support, indicators of economic activity and employment have strengthened.”
